description: This Java source file defines the DetailActivity class, an Android activity that displays detailed information including an image and title, with support for shared element transitions and image loading via Picasso.

classes.name: DetailActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that shows detailed information with shared element transition support, loading images with Picasso.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, retrieves item data, sets transition names, and loads item details.

methods.name: loadItem
methods.description: Sets the title text and loads images depending on Android version and transition listener status.

methods.name: loadThumbnail
methods.description: Loads the thumbnail image into the ImageView using Picasso.

methods.name: loadFullSizeImage
methods.description: Loads the full-size image into the ImageView using Picasso.

methods.name: addTransitionListener
methods.description: Adds a transition listener to load the full image after transition ends; returns true if listener added.
